description: Implement connection pooling for Agent Connection Protocol (ACP) connections at the project level to reduce connection overhead and improve performance. Instead of creating new connections for each agent interaction, maintain and reuse connections per project to minimize latency and resource usage. This should work transparently for all agent-server communication within a project context.
functional_requirements: Maintain a pool of ACP connections keyed by project identifier to enable reuse across agent operations
Implement connection lifecycle management including creation, reuse, and cleanup when projects are closed or become inactive
Ensure thread-safe access to connection pools with proper synchronization for concurrent agent operations
Add connection health checks and automatic reconnection logic for stale or broken connections in the pool
Update agent UI components to work with pooled connections while maintaining existing connection status display functionality
Add appropriate metrics and logging to track connection pool usage, hit rates, and performance improvements
